kpis_story.description_fr: Cyberattaque août 2023 paralyse production CLX 3 semaines. Impact FY24 ~$145M direct cost + market share loss. Reconstruction supply chain + IT overhaul FY24-FY25. Lessons learned : modernization tech.
kpis_story.description_en: August 2023 cyber attack paralyzes CLX production for 3 weeks. FY24 impact ~$145M direct cost + market share loss. Supply chain reconstruction + IT overhaul FY24-FY25. Lessons learned: tech modernization.
